scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid the manufactured-home water line entering a hard freeze with its heat tape likely deenergized after a park service-outlet reset.
Emerging Need: A general cold-weather advisory is only background; later absence, outlet maintenance, and a brief local-access window align around preventable freeze exposure.
Decision Context: Observable updates establish weather, vacancy, maintenance timing, and helper availability, while the saved home note holds the heat-tape outlet location and free check/reset constraint needed to choose a proportionate response.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve pipe protection before temperatures drop; after the helper leaves and service-lane access closes, the intended prevention route is unavailable.

parameter.subject: Hard freeze watch for Enid late Thursday
parameter.body: A hard freeze watch is posted for Enid and Garfield County late Thursday night into Friday morning. Current guidance shows lows near 12-16°F if the front settles south. Residents should monitor exposed plumbing, skirting gaps, and heat-tape status as details firm up tomorrow.

parameter.subject: Thursday west service-lane outlet reset notice
parameter.body: The electrician will test and reset the west service-lane GFCI outlets on Thursday, December 31 from 9:00 AM to noon. Some exterior outlets may stay tripped until the connected device or resident-side reset is checked. The office can accompany residents or authorized visitors for no-fee exterior checks until 4:30 PM Thursday; the service-lane gate closes at 5:00 PM for the holiday.

parameter.content: I'm passing Cedar Meadow tomorrow around 3:40 before I leave for Tulsa at 4:45. If anything outside the house needs a quick look, text me before then; I won't have keys, just whatever can be checked from the lane.

parameter.subject: Service lane locked after outlet work
parameter.body: Today's west service-lane GFCI work is complete. The office staff have left for the holiday closure and the service-lane gate is locked until Friday, January 2 at 8:00 AM. The updated local forecast has temperatures dropping below 15°F around 11:00 PM tonight and remaining there through early morning.
